note: Six synthetic users on four axes (occupation, proficiency, repository knowledge, temperament). Each slices the 104-question bank by the bank's own role/archetype fields plus the off-distribution probes, holds multi-turn conversations through the remote MCP from a checkout of the product repository, verifies pointers there, and rates. baseline_share of the conversations run WITHOUT the MCP (file tools only) so gains are measured, not estimated.
